Language-assisted interpretation is disabled by default and is applied only when explicitly enabled.
τL,1=0.05, τL,2=0.15. Explain for gap strictly above 0.15; suggest for gap strictly above 0.05 and at most 0.15; refine for gap at most 0.05. These are dimensionless score gaps.
Gap is treated as zero; mode is refine.
Lref=3, Lexplain=5, Lprof=5. Refine receives scores for up to three candidates but may receive community profiles for up to five. Explain/suggest list up to five scored candidates.
All supplied sensor observations, sorted by signed value and rendered to four decimals; partition sums and maxima of absolute change; sensor-to-partition assignments; partition adjacency.

For up to five candidates: node count, scenario count, maximum-drop range and up to three representative leak-node identifiers. This is not the node-stripped context used in the separate re-ranking experiment below.
Requests spatial, topological and pattern checks and instructs retention of Top-1 when at least two of three checks pass.

The label extracted from the response must be in the original Top-3 and differ from the numerical Top-1. The generated check assessments and reported number of passed checks are recorded, but acceptance requires neither a threshold count nor an independently recomputed hydraulic check.
Suggestions and rationales are recorded; numerical predictions remain unchanged.
The revised partition label and whether it changed are recorded. The numerical Top-3/Top-5 lists and scores remain unchanged.
Generation failures and responses without a usable extracted label retain the numerical prediction.

The language interface is available as an optional component. The projection results in Tables S2 and S3 did not use it, and the mode description does not establish a gate-related accuracy gain or explanation quality.
